whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text:
I'm going to grab the other stuff.
Oh, come on in, Cheryl.
I'm going to join you.
I'm Jack Kalish, and this is Rachel Chavarella,
and we are Everything Good Studio,
and this is our piece, Curtain of Light.
Curtain of Light is an interactive volumetric projection.
So it detects kind of where people are in the space,
and this line projected on the ground through this haze
creates a curtain that's suspended in midair
that reacts to people when they touch and interact with the light.
So it kind of makes the light almost like a physical light.
It's a physical presence and acts as a barrier
that divides the space and also creates this medium
through which people can interact with each other.
So conceptually, the piece is sort of about walls and boundaries.
We develop...
We developed it originally during an artist's residency in Berlin,
and at the time we were thinking about walls
and how boundaries are sort of these arbitrary constructs,
and we wanted to create a piece that kind of speaks to that
and gives people a space where they can confront this concept of a boundary.
So we developed this piece.
And we're going to show you the process of creating a wall.
